home.headline: Is your system
home.lead: Find out in minutes. Our self-assessment wizard asks plain-language questions about your system, maps them to the right security frameworks for your jurisdiction, and gives you an instant report.

saCard.title: Security Self-Assessment
saCard.subtitle: Free preliminary evaluation
saCard.step1d: — select type, jurisdiction, and sensitivity level
saCard.step2d: — tailored to your frameworks (ITSG-33, NIST, GDPR, etc.)
saCard.step3d: — what's secure, what's critical, and next steps
saCard.note: Access code required — request one instantly

portal.title: Client Portal
portal.subtitle: Submit intakes, access assessments, or sign in to manage your security posture.
portal.submitIntakeD: Starting a new project? Submit a security assessment intake with your project details and data classification.
portal.enterCodeD: Received an invitation from a security practitioner? Enter your access code to provide evidence for your assessment.
portal.practitionerD: Security assessors and practitioners can log in to manage projects, review intakes, create assessments, and conduct audits.

gate.title: Security Self-Assessment
gate.subtitle: Evaluate your system's security posture against applicable frameworks.
gate.requestD: Don't have a code? Submit a request and our security team will review it. Once approved, you'll receive an access code by email.
gate.name: Your Name
gate.systemQ: What system do you want to assess?
gate.systemP: Brief description — e.g. public-facing web portal for citizen feedback
gate.submittedD: Your request has been sent to our security team. You'll receive an email at {{email}} with an access code once approved.
gate.submittedNote: This typically takes less than 24 hours.

sa.title: Security Self-Assessment
sa.subtitle: Evaluate your system's security posture against applicable frameworks
sa.tellUsD: Select the type, jurisdiction, and describe your system. We'll determine which security frameworks apply and generate tailored questions.
sa.fwApply: Security frameworks that may apply to your system:
sa.describe: Describe your system in plain language
sa.describeP: e.g. We have a public-facing web portal built on WordPress that collects citizen feedback forms.
sa.analyzingD: Generating tailored security questions based on applicable frameworks
sa.questionsHint: Answer honestly — this helps identify gaps. Skip questions you're unsure about.
sa.genReportD: Analyzing answers and mapping to framework controls
sa.doNotClose: Please do not close this page — this may take up to 30 seconds.
sa.securedWarn: Based on your self-reported answers. Should be verified during a formal assessment.
